envelope_layers.detail: RLogs reconstructs ordered TCP bytes before BPSR framing; physical segmentation and retransmission layout are not retained in the sanitized marker proof.
Six-byte header [total_length:u32 big-endian][fragment:u16 big-endian], fragment 5 with high bit reserved as the zstd flag; payload begins with a four-byte frame sequence.
Six-byte frame header followed by [service:u64][stub:u32][call:u32][method:u32], all decoded big-endian, then the application body.
UseSlotRequest field 4 is 80 bytes: IV 16, HMAC-SHA256 32, AES-CBC ciphertext 32; the MAC covers IV plus ciphertext.

derived_observed_lengths.conditions: Observed fields are present once, the attribute envelope is 80 bytes, and UUID, begin-time, and session-sequence values remain in their observed protobuf varint-width bands.

remaining_scope_limits: Only one current-build marker request has retained physical-capture evidence.
